legend: Vasya and Petya have invented a new game. Vasya takes a stripe consisting of 1 × n square and paints the squares black and white. After that Petya can start moves — during a move he may choose any two neighboring squares of one color and repaint these two squares any way he wants, perhaps in different colors. Petya can only repaint the squares in white and black colors. Petya’s aim is to repaint the stripe so that no two neighboring squares were of one color. Help Petya, using the given initial coloring, find the minimum number of moves Petya needs to win.
input: The first line contains number n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000) which represents the stripe’s length. The second line contains exactly n symbols — the line’s initial coloring. 0 corresponds to a white square, 1 corresponds to a black one.
output: If Petya cannot win with such an initial coloring, print -1. Otherwise print the minimum number of moves Petya needs to win.
note: In the first sample Petya can take squares 1 and 2. He repaints square 1 to black and square 2 to white.
In the second sample Petya can take squares 2 and 3. He repaints square 2 to white and square 3 to black.

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，Petya 可以选择第 1 个和第 2 个方格。他将第 1 个方格重新涂成黑色，将第 2 个方格重新涂成白色。
在第二个样例中，Petya 可以选择第 2 个和第 3 个方格。他将第 2 个方格重新涂成白色，将第 3 个方格重新涂成黑色。

legend.ai: Vasya 和 Petya 发明了一种新游戏。Vasya 取出一条由 1 × n 个方格组成的条带，并将这些方格涂成黑色和白色。之后 Petya 可以开始移动——每次移动中，他可以选择任意两个相邻且颜色相同的方格，并以任意方式重新涂色这两个方格，它们甚至可以被涂成不同的颜色。Petya 只能将方格涂成白色或黑色。Petya 的目标是将条带重新涂色，使得不存在两个相邻方格颜色相同。请帮助 Petya，根据给定的初始涂色情况，求出 Petya 获胜所需的最少移动次数。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 1000），表示条带的长度。第二行包含恰好 n 个字符，表示条带的初始涂色情况。0 表示白色方格，1 表示黑色方格。

output.ai: 如果 Petya 无法从这种初始涂色情况获胜，输出 -1。否则，输出 Petya 获胜所需的最少移动次数。
